selected.name: Phoebe Bridgers
selected.description: Phoebe Bridgers is an American singer-songwriter known for her emotive indie rock and folk music.

properties.description: Kacey Musgraves is a Grammy-winning American country singer-songwriter whose music blends classic country twang, intimate singer-songwriter storytelling, and modern pop-influenced production. She is known for witty, observational lyrics that often challenge social norms and for bringing a progressive voice and broader sonic palette to contemporary country music.

Tyler Childers (born 1991) is an American singer-songwriter from Lawrence County, Kentucky, celebrated for straightforward, roots-driven songs that merge country, bluegrass and Appalachian folk. He rose from the regional independent scene to national prominence following the 2017 release of Purgatory; his songwriting emphasizes vivid storytelling, working-class life, religion, love and the complexities of rural Appalachia.

Taylor Swift is a globally successful American singer-songwriter whose career began in country music and evolved through pop, indie and alternative styles. She is known for autobiographical, narrative songwriting, careful melodic craft, commercial success across streaming and touring, and high-profile industry moves including re-recording her catalog to reclaim ownership.

Dolly Parton is a prolific American country music singer-songwriter, actress, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. With a career spanning six decades, she is celebrated for her prolific songwriting, distinctive high, clear voice, and her crossover success into pop and film. Beyond music, she built a major entertainment business (Dollywood), runs a global childhood literacy program (Imagination Library), and is widely regarded as one of country music's most influential cultural figures.

Colter Wall is a Canadian singer-songwriter from Swift Current, Saskatchewan, celebrated for his resonant baritone and revivalist approach to traditional country, western and folk music. Emerging in the mid-2010s, Wall's work emphasizes sparse arrangements, narrative balladry and themes drawn from rural life and the open plains.

Maren Morris is an American singer and songwriter who rose to prominence in the country music scene with her distinctive blend of country, pop, and R&B influences. She gained widespread recognition with her hit single "My Church" and has since released multiple successful albums. Morris is known for her strong vocal performances, songwriting skills, and genre-crossing style that appeals to both country and pop audiences.

Morgan Wallen is an American country music singer and songwriter who rose to fame with his unique blend of traditional country music and modern influences such as country pop and southern rock. He gained widespread recognition with his debut album and has since become one of the prominent figures in contemporary country music, known for his distinctive vocal style and storytelling through his lyrics.

The Highwomen is an American country music supergroup formed in 2019, consisting of Brandi Carlile, Natalie Hemby, Amanda Shires, and Maren Morris. The group was created to address the underrepresentation of women in country music and to celebrate female voices and stories. Their music blends traditional country with contemporary Americana and folk influences, featuring rich harmonies and storytelling lyrics.

Chris Stapleton is an American singer-songwriter and guitarist whose music blends country, Americana, blues and soul. He first gained wide attention as a Nashville songwriter and as lead vocalist of the bluegrass group The SteelDrivers, then broke through as a solo artist with the 2015 album Traveller. Stapleton is noted for his raspy, emotive baritone, roots-oriented arrangements, and songwriting craft; he has won multiple Grammys and revitalized mainstream interest in more traditional, soulful country sounds.

Ashley Nicolette Frangipane (professionally known as Halsey) is an American singer-songwriter whose genre-blending alt-pop and confessional lyrics brought rapid mainstream success. She released her debut EP Room 93 in 2014 after signing to Astralwerks, and her breakthrough LP Badlands (2015) reached No. 2 on the US Billboard 200 and went platinum. She has scored global hits both as a lead artist and a collaborator (notably The Chainsmokers' "Closer"), released multiple successful studio albums including Hopeless Fountain Kingdom (2017), Manic (2020) and If I Can't Have Love, I Want Power (2021), and is known for outspoken advocacy around mental-health awareness and survivors' rights.

Austin Richard Post, known professionally as Post Malone, is an American singer, rapper, and songwriter who rose to fame with the 2015 single "White Iverson." He is known for a melodic, autotuned vocal style and for blending hip-hop, pop, rock and country influences. Post Malone has released multiple multi-platinum albums (including Stoney, Beerbongs & Bentleys, and Hollywood's Bleeding), landed numerous number-one singles, and is a frequent collaborator across genres. His commercially focused songwriting, distinctive image and prolific streaming numbers have made him one of the most prominent crossover artists of the late 2010s and early 2020s.

Mason Ramsey is an American country singer and internet personality who gained fame as a young boy for his yodeling skills, particularly after a viral video of him yodeling in a Walmart went viral. He is known for blending traditional country music with modern country pop influences.

Lizzo, born Melissa Viviane Jefferson, is an American singer, rapper, songwriter, and flutist. She blends elements of pop, hip hop, R&B, and soul in her music, often incorporating funk and dance influences. Lizzo is celebrated for her powerful vocals, charismatic stage presence, and messages of body positivity and self-love. She rose to mainstream fame with hits like "Truth Hurts" and "Good as Hell," and is known for her energetic performances and flute playing.

Luke Combs is a prominent American country music singer and songwriter who rose to fame in the late 2010s. Known for his rich baritone voice and heartfelt storytelling, Combs blends traditional country sounds with modern influences, creating music that resonates with a wide audience. His songs often explore themes of love, heartbreak, and everyday life, earning him critical acclaim and commercial success. He has released multiple chart-topping albums and singles, establishing himself as one of the leading figures in contemporary country music.

Kelsea Ballerini is an American country pop singer and songwriter who rose to fame with her debut album 'The First Time' and hit singles like 'Love Me Like You Mean It.' She blends traditional country elements with contemporary pop sounds, creating a fresh and accessible style within the country music genre. Ballerini has been recognized for her strong vocal performances, relatable songwriting, and has won several awards including the Academy of Country Music's New Female Vocalist of the Year.
